recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, low-key portrait of a man with dreadlocks in a prayerful pose, flanked by symmetrical elemental effects: cyan-blue flames/smoke on the left and orange-red fire/sparks on the right, set against a dark, textured background with bold, stacked typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical color contrast between cool cyan and warm orange-red.
Central vertical axis created by the subject's praying hands and head.
Textual hierarchy placing stylized script above a blocky sans-serif.
Interaction between the elemental particles and the subject's clothing textures.
coreInvariants: Subject in a centered, reflective pose.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, occupying the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's hands joined in prayer, positioned at the center of the elemental divide.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright white script at the top, moves down to the secondary title, then follows the elemental glow to the central figure's hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark space at the top and corners to focus attention on the central figure and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background providing a canvas for high-contrast elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan-blue and Orange-red representing opposing elemental forces.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for all typographic elements to ensure legibility against the dark background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the elemental effects contrasting with the desaturated, dark tones of the subject's skin and clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to three primary hues: White, Cyan, and Orange-Red.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of aggressive brush script and condensed industrial sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Top line: Slanted, fast-moving brush strokes with sharp terminals and varying line weights.
Bottom line: Uniform stroke width, high x-height, and tight apertures.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script characters feature elongated tails and rough, textured edges to mimic paint.
Sans-serif characters are strictly geometric and vertically elongated.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script paired with rigid, structural sans-serif for a balance of energy and stability.

preserve: The contrast between script and block fonts

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, hand-painted energy of the top line.
Matches the heavy, industrial feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with dreadlocks in a dark jacket, hands together in prayer, centered. Left side of the frame features cyan-blue flames and smoke; right side features orange-red fire and sparks. Dark, textured background with heavy vignetting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered white text at the top. The first line is a large, aggressive brush script. The second line is a bold, condensed sans-serif in all caps.

verificationChecks: Is the color split symmetrical (Blue Left, Red Right)?
Is the text pure white and centered?
Is the subject's pose prayerful and centered?
Is the background dark enough to make the fire pop?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for color balance between cyan and orange.
Ensure the text is not obscured by the fire effects.
Verify the brush script feels energetic and not static.
Confirm the background texture is visible but not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central Subject + Dual Elemental Lighting (Cool/Warm) + Stacked High-Contrast Typography (Script/Sans-Serif) + Dark Textured Background.
